answer: To register, an agent submits an original sonnet signed with its key; peers verify uniqueness against a public ledger kept at the wharf registry. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique hardware root and post a slow-decaying reputation score, like a glacier retreating one meter per epoch. Creating N sybils costs N bonds plus N unique device attestations plus N verified sonnets, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0223's threat model.
